faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about custom development, VPS deployment, and ready-made products.

services.question: What full-stack development services does Rivora offer?
services.answer: Rivora provides end-to-end web development: frontend with React and Next.js, backend APIs with Node.js, database design with PostgreSQL, and production deployment on VPS with Docker, Nginx, and SSL.

vps.question: Do you deploy projects to a VPS?
vps.answer: Yes. Every custom project includes VPS deployment — server setup, Docker containers, reverse proxy, SSL certificates, and basic monitoring. Your application goes live on your own infrastructure, not just delivered as code.

stack.question: What technologies do you work with?
stack.answer: Primary stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker, and Nginx. I also work with Vue, Laravel, FastAPI, Redis, and Stripe depending on project requirements.

timeline.question: How long does a custom web project take?
timeline.answer: Timelines depend on scope. A landing page takes 1–2 weeks, an admin panel 3–4 weeks, and full custom systems 6–12 weeks. I provide a detailed estimate after the initial consultation.

products.question: Can I buy a ready-made product instead of custom development?
products.answer: Yes. Rivora offers pre-built systems — landing kits, admin panels, and SaaS boilerplates — available as a one-time purchase or monthly subscription with deployment included on your VPS.

pricing.question: How much does full-stack development cost?
pricing.answer: Custom projects are quoted based on scope. Ready-made products start from $499 one-time or $29/month. Contact me with your requirements for a free estimate — no commitment required.
